entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5478"/><div sID="gen8297" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5478"/><hi type="bold">7. Arise, O Lord--</hi>God is figuratively represented as asleep to denote His apparent indifference (<reference osisRef="Ps.7.6">Psa 7:6</reference>). The use of "cheekbone" and "teeth" represents his enemies as fierce, like wild beasts ready to devour (<reference osisRef="Ps.27.2">Psa 27:2</reference>), and smiting their cheekbone (<reference osisRef="1Kgs.22.24">1Ki 22:24</reference>) denotes violence and insult.<div eID="gen8297" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen8298" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">thou hast broken--</hi>God took his part, utterly depriving the enemy of power to injure. <div eID="gen8298" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 7. Arise, O Lord-- God is figuratively represented as asleep to denote His apparent indifference ( Psa 7:6 ). The use of "cheekbone" and "teeth" represents his enemies as fierce, like wild beasts ready to devour ( Psa 27:2 ), and smiting their cheekbone ( 1Ki 22:24 ) denotes violence and insult. thou hast broken-- God took his part, utterly depriving the enemy of power to injure.
